title: Vietnamese Bun Bo Kho
description: A vegetarian take on the traditional Vietnamese beef noodle soup, featuring a rich and flavorful broth made with kho and spices.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add ground and cook until browned, breaking up with a spoon as needed.
Add kho and cook for 2 minutes.
Add cardamom, bun, bo, broth, and soy sauce. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with cilantro and accompanied by pillowy bread.
Soak bun in hot water for 5 minutes before serving.
Assemble the dish by placing bun on a plate, then ladling the hot broth and kho mixture over the top.
